added: The Advanced panel now sends the figure details you can pick there, such as the dancers or the hand, to ContraDB where ContraDB has them. A detail ContraDB doesn't have is left out, and the line above the results says some Advanced conditions were left out.
changed: A figure with details no longer stops an Advanced search of ContraDB. Only a tag, a section, or a move ContraDB has no exact match for still does, and the message now says "section" instead of "details".

added: translateDanceFilterToContraDb translates a figure leaf's parameters onto ContraDB's positional filters and reports the ones it left out in ContraDbAdvancedExpression.ignoredParams.
changed: ContraDbAdvancedUnsupported.figureDetail now means a phrase section only; figure parameters no longer refuse a figure.
